projection: equirectangular, north up, east to the right, lon 0 at the centre
HYBRID: real large-scale albedo (USGS/DLR mosaic low-passed 1.5 deg) x artist terrain detail (Astra-Planetshine oberon, rotated) + analytic crater (139 km crater at -1.7 N, 248.2 E)
normal: tangent space (x east, y north), true scale: artist bump high-passed (span 8 km) + analytic crater profiles
source: DLR Cassini ISS Mimas global basemap (June 2017), USGS Astrogeology mosaic archive + Astra-Planetshine "Uranus Project Missing Data" terrain
